description.value:
You issue a one-word command to a droid or construct you can see within range. It must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or carry out that command on its next turn; a piloted construct with a conscious, unincapacitated pilot adds the pilot's Intelligence modifier to the save.

Typical commands include Approach, Deactivate, Drop, Flee, and Halt, each producing an intuitive effect described by the power; if the target cannot comply, the power ends.

Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional droid or construct within 30 feet of the others for each slot level above 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
